<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs` from the OpenAPI document (`data_avalanche_api::openapi`). Don't edit: change the source and run it again. -->

Every node serves the API on `globals.api.address`. `globals.api.auth` decides which credentials a node takes: none, basic (one user, admin), or a bearer JWT whose roles are mapped (config §6.3). The [`openapi.json`](/data-avalanche/openapi.json) this page is rendered from is `GET /v1/openapi.json` on a node.

**Roles.** A route's *least role* is the lowest that may call it: `viewer` reads, `operator` also runs the pipeline commands, snapshots and config reloads, `admin` also makes a node leave the cluster or shut down. With `auth: none` every caller is `admin`; with `auth: basic` the one user is `admin`; with `jwt` or `oauth2` the token's roles are mapped by `roles_claim` and `role_mapping`.

**Answers.** Every body is a JSON object; a refusal carries an `error` string. Every route can also answer `503` (the node is starting or stopping, or its state can't be read) and, unless `auth` is `none`, `401` (no credentials, or ones that don't verify) and `403` (the caller's role is below the route's). A `202` means accepted, not done: a pipeline command or a snapshot job is carried out by the node that holds the pipeline's lease, a reload is published, a leave or a shutdown is under way on the node called.

**Outside `/v1`**, with no credentials: `GET /health/live` (the process answers), `GET /health/ready` (`200` once the node runs its config, `503` before and while it stops) and `GET /metrics` (Prometheus text).

## pipelines

Pipelines: their state, and the lifecycle commands.

### `GET /v1/pipelines`

Every pipeline: its desired and actual states and its holder

Least role: `viewer`.


| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | the pipelines |

### `GET /v1/pipelines/{id}`

A pipeline: its states, its holder, its position and its halted tables

Least role: `viewer`.

- Path parameter `id`: the pipeline's id.

| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | the pipeline |
| `404` | no such pipeline in the generation this node runs |

### `POST /v1/pipelines/{id}/flush`

Flush now

Least role: `operator`.

- Path parameter `id`: the pipeline's id.

| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | paused: flushed already |
| `202` | asked: the owner acts at its next poll |
| `404` | no such pipeline in the generation this node runs |
| `409` | stopped, or no node holds the lease |

### `POST /v1/pipelines/{id}/pause`

Pause: flush to a transaction boundary, then read nothing; the connection and the lease stay

Least role: `operator`.

- Path parameter `id`: the pipeline's id.

| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | paused already |
| `202` | the desired state is paused |
| `404` | no such pipeline in the generation this node runs |
| `409` | the pipeline is stopped |

### `POST /v1/pipelines/{id}/restart`

Restart: discard what is unflushed and replay from the checkpoint, under the same lease; a pipeline in ERROR runs again

Least role: `operator`.

- Path parameter `id`: the pipeline's id.

| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `202` | asked: the owner acts at its next poll |
| `404` | no such pipeline in the generation this node runs |
| `409` | paused, stopped, or no node holds the lease |

### `POST /v1/pipelines/{id}/resume`

Resume a paused or stopped pipeline

Least role: `operator`.

- Path parameter `id`: the pipeline's id.

| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | running already |
| `202` | the desired state is running |
| `404` | no such pipeline in the generation this node runs |

### `GET /v1/pipelines/{id}/snapshots`

The pipeline's snapshot jobs, oldest first

Least role: `viewer`.

- Path parameter `id`: the pipeline's id.

| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | the jobs |
| `404` | no such pipeline in the generation this node runs |

### `POST /v1/pipelines/{id}/snapshots`

Snapshot tables on demand, `{"tables": [...]}`, each named exactly; one outside the config is copied, not streamed

Least role: `operator`.

- Path parameter `id`: the pipeline's id.
- Body: `application/json`.

| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `202` | the job is queued: the owner restarts the worker, which takes its tables |
| `404` | no such pipeline in the generation this node runs |
| `409` | paused, stopped, no node holds the lease, or an unfinished job holds a table |
| `422` | the body names no table, a glob, or a table not in the source's form |

### `POST /v1/pipelines/{id}/stop`

Stop: flush, and close the source connection; the lease stays

Least role: `operator`.

- Path parameter `id`: the pipeline's id.

| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | stopped already |
| `202` | the desired state is stopped |
| `404` | no such pipeline in the generation this node runs |

## snapshots

Snapshot jobs started through the API.

### `GET /v1/snapshots/{job_id}`

A snapshot job: its status and each table's

Least role: `viewer`.

- Path parameter `job_id`: the snapshot job's id, `<pipeline id>~<suffix>`.

| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | the job |
| `404` | no such job |

## config

The config generation the cluster runs: validate, publish, status.

### `POST /v1/config/reload`

Publish the node's file as the next config generation

Least role: `operator`.


| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | the file is the generation the cluster runs |
| `202` | published: the generation |
| `409` | other nodes published first, every time |
| `422` | invalid, or it changes a restart-only field: the report |

### `GET /v1/config/status`

The generation the cluster runs, and each member's

Least role: `viewer`.


| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | the generations |

### `POST /v1/config/validate`

Check a config, the body or else the node's file: what a reload of it would change. Nothing is published

Least role: `operator`.

- Body: `application/yaml`.

| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | it loads: its warnings and the changes |
| `422` | invalid, or it changes a restart-only field: the report |

## cluster

Membership and leases.

### `POST /v1/cluster/leave`

Leave the cluster: hand every pipeline off; the process stays up, not ready

Least role: `admin`.


| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `202` | the leave is under way |
| `409` | leaving already |

### `GET /v1/cluster/status`

The members this node sees, and each pipeline's lease holder

Least role: `viewer`.


| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | the members and the holders |

## admin

The node's process.

### `POST /v1/admin/shutdown`

Shut down: leave the cluster, then end the process

Least role: `admin`.


| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `202` | the shutdown is under way |
| `409` | shutting down already |

## openapi.json

The document this page is rendered from.

### `GET /v1/openapi.json`

This document

Least role: `viewer`.


| Status | When |
|---|---|
| `200` | the OpenAPI document |
